mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% over the last three months indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% in the last three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP by more than 2% over the last quarter signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 increased by more than 2% in the last quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% over the last month signals a supply shock, leading to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures by more than 5% each over the last two months signals a strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS increase > 5% each in 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by more than 5% each in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over the last month signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% over the last two months signals deflationary pressure, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP and consumer price index by more than 1% each over the last quarter signals inflationary growth, increasing corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL increase > 1% each in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 1% each in the last quarter.
